Name: Snowglobe Sip
Design brief: One squat rounded opaque ice-blue potion bottle with a broad white cap shaped like a snowball, navy collar, simple white embossed snowflake on a cream front label panel and a thick pale-blue base. The bottle is solid glossy ceramic, not see-through. No text, no floating snow or liquid splashes.

Name: Snowball Lobber
Design brief: One playful chunky snowball-launching toy gadget, a chamfered cobalt-blue box housing with navy trim, short wide ivory barrel aimed toward upper left, an open scoop-shaped cyan hopper on top holding THREE attached chunky white snowballs, orange safety muzzle rim, a short blue grip and cream side panel with a simple snowball emblem. Clearly a snowball launcher distinct from a crystal freeze ray. No ammo floating outside the hopper, no beam or realistic firearm details.

Name: Bubble Blower
Design brief: One chunky hand-held bubble blower toy with a bright pink rounded rectangular housing, cream side panel with three simple cyan bubble shapes, a wide hollow turquoise ring nozzle attached at the front, a short navy rubber grip and a squat yellow soap reservoir fitted below the housing. One complete object, no bubbles floating outside it, no words.

Name: Slippy Banana
Design brief: One oversized cartoon banana peel with THREE thick yellow peel flaps curving outward from a central cream stump, rounded brown stem tip. All three flaps form one connected object and lie in a compact triangular footprint. Bright glossy broad shading, no detached fruit, no face, no floor.

Name: Spring Glove
Design brief: One red padded cartoon boxing glove mounted on a short chunky compression spring emerging from a small cream-and-cobalt toy box base. Glove tilted three-quarter toward viewer, exactly THREE thick navy spring loops, orange button on the side of the base. All parts mechanically connected, compact silhouette, no arm or wearer.

Name: Sticky Honey
Design brief: One squat amber honey pot with an opaque golden body, navy reinforced rim, fitted cream lid with a chunky yellow knob, broad sculpted honey drips down the shoulder and one simple embossed hexagonal honeycomb emblem on front. A short cream carrying loop attached at side, no loose dipper, no text, no puddle.

Name: Whoopee Whump
Design brief: One plump bright coral-red whoopee cushion, round flattened rubber body with a thick broad dark-red edge seam and a short attached neck valve at the top. A large cream comic puff-cloud symbol embossed on the front, no writing. Three-quarter view makes its inflated thickness clear. No actual gas cloud.

Name: Magnet Mover
Design brief: One chunky horseshoe-magnet toy gadget, a large red U-shaped magnet with pale-cyan squared pole caps, joined at the curved base to a short cream-and-navy handgrip with a big orange thumb switch. Broad navy edge trim, glossy rounded toy proportions. No floating metal, electric arcs, text or additional objects.

Name: Ricochet Flyer
Design brief: One chunky three-armed rounded toy boomerang with a cream central circular hub, three broad cyan curved blades with orange rubber tip caps and deep navy edge seams. Three arms attached to one hub, smoothly rounded blunt edges. Three-quarter slight tilt to show thickness, no motion trails, no symbols or text.

Name: Pop-Up Surprise
Design brief: One cheerful wind-up jack-in-the-box toy with a red chamfered cube, cream panel with one large gold star, cobalt-blue hinged lid open behind, a short thick navy spring topped by a goofy mint-green round monster head with two tiny cream horns and a big friendly smile. Small gold winding crank attached to box side. All parts connected, no confetti, no detached lid.
